fix_context: Follow-up fix: compound-node parent width/height styles are ignored by Cytoscape when children are present; fix uses persisted style dimensions and relies on Cytoscape compound-node natural floor rather than fighting the ignored style.

test_scenario.description: One parent container node ('Single Child Parent', id=single-parent-1776451510) with exactly one child ('Single Child Node', id=single-child-1776451510). Both nodes were pre-existing in workspace HT050-WS-1776451504.

expand.method: Drag SE handle +80px right, +80px down via PointerEvent sequence (pointerdown → pointermove × 10 → pointerup)
expand.notes: Container visually and dimensionally expanded. Child node remained inside parent throughout.

shrink.notes: Container shrank back to the compound-node minimum (driven by child size + padding). No visual corruption.

clamp.method: Extreme drag: SE handle -300px inward (beyond NW handle position)
clamp.expected_minimum_bb: ~134×139 canvas-px (child 86×91 + 24px padding each side); Cytoscape compound sizing floors at ~186×212 including label overhead
clamp.notes: Container correctly refused to shrink below the Cytoscape compound-node minimum. No crash, no negative size, child remained inside parent.

post_refresh_geometry.notes: Style dimensions persisted exactly (362.78×364.20 identical before and after F5). Post-refresh bounding box is slightly larger (415×441) because the compound node re-computes the display BB as MAX(stored style, children natural size), which is geometrically sane and correct. Child node still inside parent. All 7 canvas nodes present.

summary: All four test steps pass. Expand increases compound node size correctly. Shrink reduces the node toward the child-driven floor. The clamp engages at the natural Cytoscape compound-node minimum and cannot be overridden by dragging. Post-refresh geometry is sane: stored style dimensions survive the reload exactly, and the compound structure is intact.

side_finding.title: Cytoscape node labels render as literal 'data(label) Draft' template string
side_finding.description: All nodes in edit mode display the raw Cytoscape label template expression 'data(label)' concatenated with the string 'Draft' instead of the actual device name. Affects all node types, all topologies tested. Not related to HT-050 resize.
side_finding.steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open any topology. 2. Click EDIT. 3. Observe node labels showing 'data(label)\nDraft' instead of device names.
side_finding.note: The 'Draft' portion is the personal-draft badge, which appears to have been concatenated into the label template. The 'data(label)' portion suggests the Cytoscape label template is not being evaluated at the JS level — the template string is being passed through raw.
